entities.description: Information element containing the previous location area identification of the UE.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE performs both EPS attach and non-EPS services attach simultaneously.

Inclusion of the old location area identification IE is conditional upon the UE having a valid location area identification.
